description: A pair of subtle, parallel linear depressions oriented NE–SW, each approximately 100 m in length and separated by ~12 m. The northern end of the feature turns at a right angle, forming a shallow U-shaped drainage channel. These lines sit in very low‐relief terrain (<5° slope) and stand out in the DTM second‐order curvature filter (0.003–0.004 m⁻¹).

A single, straight channel trending NW–SE, ~220 m long, visible as a linear trough in the hillshade and curvature derivatives. The feature coincides with a persistent moisture anomaly in the NIR band (bright signature), suggesting enhanced soil moisture retention typical of anthropogenic ditch‐and‐ridge systems.
